# BiologicalNoiseMimicry

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The emulation of biological neural variability patterns in artificial networks to replicate natural robustness mechanisms. Provides a biologically grounded approach to improving artificial network performance in in-network neuromorphic computing.
